nodes.label: Release 3.9.0 — branch hygiene, standards conformance, PR gates
Release 3.8.0 — agent handoff, team layer, verification
Documentation drift (counts, hooks, stale rule copies)
nodes.rationale: Three phase skills were reading outdated copies of shared rules — a silent behavior bug, not just docs.

nodes.label: Branch hygiene (nothing left in branches)
nodes.rationale: Absorbed branches deleted remote+local in the same deploy; absorption verified (git branch --merged, git cherry, tree test), never assumed. Stale branches read as pending work and hide real unreleased work.

nodes.label: QA Dimension 9 — Standards conformance
nodes.rationale: A gate that is never verified is not a gate; departures without deviations.md entry are High blocking findings.

nodes.label: PR gates verification before prod OK
nodes.rationale: The method took you to production's door and never checked whether it opened.

nodes.label: Git host detection (project.json:git_platform)
nodes.rationale: Deploy platform and git host differ; hardcoded gh CLI failed on Azure Repos/GitLab.

nodes.label: Agent handoff (handoff.md + state.json)
nodes.rationale: A lone agent rotates too and has the least safety net.

nodes.label: Decision log D-NN / C-NN with cross-check
nodes.rationale: Every entry carries what it does NOT say to prevent over-applying a decision.

nodes.label: 18 verification failure modes
nodes.rationale: A citation is not the thing cited; exit 0 is not success; green test over uncalled code.

nodes.label: Hotfix lane (fix + BUG-NN + regression test same PR)
approvals.prod {by, date, ref}
nodes.rationale: Keeps prod approval in git history where the platform cannot enforce required reviewers.

nodes.label: Causal discipline: what CHANGED before what is WRONG
nodes.rationale: Post-mortem: a pre-existing fragile path was reported as root cause; real cause was a CSP security header change. A cause predating the incident window cannot explain the symptom.

nodes.label: AI-time estimation in minutes (10-30 min, cap 60)
nodes.rationale: Reconciled from GESTION_PROYECTOS_IA governance doc; estimates are AI execution + human review, not human hours.

nodes.label: Engineering standards layer (golden paths)
nodes.rationale: Method specified what to build but had no canonical place for how; architecture/impl drifted on tribal knowledge.

nodes.label: Method/standards separation (two planes)
nodes.rationale: Public plugin stays generic; team standards live in the team's own (possibly private) repo.

nodes.label: Convergence gate
nodes.rationale: A change is done only when no open bug/spec-gap remains and all emergent are captured.

nodes.label: Mandatory phase-close ritual
nodes.rationale: ClickUp updates documented as a should got skipped; made a numbered step.

hyperedges.label: Three-phase standards conformance gate (design decides, impl follows, QA verifies)
